description: Database for Material Characterization of Ultra-High-Performance Concrete (UHPC) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). A set of UHPC material tests was performed at the University of Houston Structural Laboratory using cylinder compression tests, direct tensile tests (DTTs), and four-point bending tests. Two UHPC mixes were used: one by Steelike® and one by Tindall Corporation. All UHPC matrices included a 2.0% fiber content by volume with 0.5-in. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Ultra-high-performance concrete, UHPC, tensile behavior, concrete. Published 2024-01-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
